name: Camping 101: Fishing
summary: At your camp, fishing can bring comfort to you and your companions. Near Sen'jin Village, Lau'Tiki can teach you to make a Fish Bowl.

sections.title: A Camp Comfort
sections.body: Once you have shown skill in fishing, speak with Lau'Tiki near Sen'jin Village. Lau'Tiki can teach you to make a Fish Bowl, a fixture for camp meant to bring joy to you and your fellow adventurers. A happier camp, the giver hopes, makes for stronger fighters.

faq.q: What can fishing do for my camp?
faq.answer: Your fishing skill can help you learn to make a Fish Bowl for your camp.

faq.q: Who teaches me to make a Fish Bowl?
faq.answer: Lau'Tiki near Sen'jin Village can teach you to make a Fish Bowl once you have shown skill in fishing.

faq.q: What is the Fish Bowl for?
faq.answer: The Fish Bowl is a camping fixture meant to bring joy to you and your fellow adventurers.

angles.text: As a fisher, you can learn to make a Fish Bowl for your camp once you have shown skill in fishing.
